economy.summary: Joined the House Republican 'Freedom Through Affordability' initiative, which proposes temporary suspensions of the state personal income tax, the gross receipts tax on electricity and telecommunications, and the gas tax, plus sales tax holidays on car seats and baby products, to cut costs for families.
economy.short: Backs initiative proposing temporary tax suspensions to cut family costs.

taxes.summary: Responding to the governor's 2025 budget address, said state spending growth is unacceptable, that he is more concerned about the amount of money taxpayers keep in their pockets than what Harrisburg thinks it needs, and that appropriated money must be used responsibly. His campaign platform pledges to hold the line on taxes and cut wasteful spending.
taxes.short: Opposes state spending growth; pledges to hold line on taxes.

abortion.summary: His campaign website describes him as pro-life and says he is committed to protecting pro-life values.
abortion.short: Campaign site describes him as pro-life.

education.summary: Introduced the Unraveling Socialism Act (HB 2209), which would require Pennsylvania public universities receiving state funding to mandate a one-credit course on communism and socialism, with case studies of China, North Korea, Cuba, the USSR, and Venezuela, beginning in the 2027-28 academic year. His campaign platform also calls for giving parents more control of their children's education.
education.short: Introduced bill requiring university course on communism; supports parental control.

healthcare.summary: Introduced House Bill 1661, which would require hospitals to report annual data on admissions and emergency room visits by undocumented immigrants so the state can analyze uncompensated care costs; he said legislators should not vote to increase health care spending without knowing how current funds are being used.
healthcare.short: Introduced bill tracking hospital costs of care for undocumented immigrants.

energy.summary: His campaign platform says he will stop job-crushing regulations, support energy independence, and stand with workers; the site does not detail specific energy or environmental proposals.
energy.short: Says he supports energy independence and opposes regulations.

guns.summary: His campaign website says he is a member of the National Rifle Association and committed to protecting Second Amendment values, and pledges to ensure police and first responders have the tools and support to keep communities safe.
guns.short: NRA member; pledges to protect Second Amendment, support police.
